description:
Diagnostic daemon to assess stale daemons and determine if they need restart or service file review. Multiple core daemons are stale: mcp_scanner (33h29m), signal_analyser (31h30m), trust_synthesiser (31h54m), threat_intel_ingestor (33h5m), attestation_engine (33h29m), risk_ranker (33h29m).

MUST: Query service_health table for all daemons with stale heartbeat (> per-daemon threshold).
MUST: For each stale daemon, check if process is still running (pid exists).
MUST: Output structured report: daemon, heartbeat_age_seconds, threshold_seconds, process_status, recommended_action (restart/service_file_review/diagnostic_needed).
MUST: Do NOT attempt to restart any daemon.
MUST NOT: Write to any table; read-only diagnostic.
This supports Section 4 freshness SLA enforcement by providing operator-ready diagnostic output.
